integrity: All integral and fundamental-group claims supported by orbit-face decomposition, integral relative homology connecting-map proof, and van Kampen; finite GF(2) verifier corroborates only dimensions 2 through 7.
scientific_limitations: Single coordinate-transposition geometric fixed spaces for inclusive Rips scale two only. Known ambient wedge theorem used. The integral fixed-point homology and pi_1 classification has no independent mathematical audit; no equivariant wedge splitting is claimed.
title: Integral fixed-point homology for coordinate swaps in scale-two hypercube Rips complexes
